race.description: Go Hire - The Events People F&M Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: HORSESHOE HILL (3) returned sharp figures over the unsuitable 1000m first up. Then sent out a firm favourite with a slick 1.4 len win over today's trip at Rosehill. Can stalk the fast tempo and put these away again. METALLIC CAT (5) fast mare due for a change of luck. Set a decent tempo at latest when she stepped up to the 1300m for a game third over 1300m at Randwick. No excuses fourth up and will prove hard to run down. SEQUISTA (9) resumes with the one 900m trial under the belt and will relish the fast tempo. Will go back from the wide draw and look for her to motor late. CREPE MYRTLE (2) blinkers come off second-up and well placed out to the 1200m. Returned from a lengthy break when she stalked the speed to run third over 1000m at Randwick in BM84 class. Each way contender from the sticky gate. NULLARBOR JANE (7) faded in the run first up and will keep improving with a few more runs under the belt.
